title: Resolutions of linear $p$-cyclic quotient singularities
summary: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic $p$, and let $C_p$ act linearly on a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space $V$, with indecomposable Jordan summands $V_{d_i}$ of dimension $d_i$. We study projective (crepant) resolutions of $V/C_p$ by constructing a model using the invariant weighted blowup. For $V=V_2^{\oplus n}$, our model is smooth and is the normalization of a blowup of $V/C_p$.
